$comment: Provenance declaration for tracked model archives. A provenance verdict is a data-lineage statement only; it is not evidence of model accuracy or predictive validity.

source_authentication.note: Hashes computed locally from the checkout and validated only by internal partition consistency (train union test == CUADv1 on distinct normalized texts). No upstream CUAD checksum was consulted. Internal consistency does not prove upstream authenticity.

tfidf_classifier.7z.reason: Trained from data/processed/clause_classifier.csv, which was built from the full data/datasets/cuad/CUADv1.json corpus (train union test). The training corpus overlaps the held-out CUAD test documents, so no leakage-free or generalization claim can be made. Retraining is a separate approval gate.

risk_classifier.7z.reason: Weakly-supervised severity model trained from the same full-CUAD-derived clause corpus, with labels produced by the rule engine. Same corpus-overlap limitation; additionally, its labels are rule-derived rather than gold.
